title: 第11章 圣女第12章 兽与人
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可再次如闪电般冲刺，她的身影在夜色中若隐若现，如同一道划破黑暗的流星。她的心跳如鼓点般急促，每一次呼吸都像是在燃烧，她能明显感觉到自己的耐力正在以惊人的速度迅速耗尽，似乎这场战斗即将成为她在不得不狼狈撤退之前的最后一搏。
他们陷入了极度的恐慌之中，然而，大部分实质性的伤害其实是由那些筑基巅峰的人造成的，他们对她那快如鬼魅的速度感到无比恼火。虽说他们的速度远比艾可快得多，但在这片茂密的草丛中想要精准地追踪到她的身影，却绝非易事，再加上他们还得时刻留意避开自己的同伴……这一系列的状况对他们而言，没有丝毫的帮助。
她再次风驰电掣般地冲刺，目光敏锐地看到有人倒在草丛里，她不禁眯起了眼睛。那个人随即开始惊恐地尖叫，那声音让黑豹脊背阵阵发凉，他再次在心底暗暗发誓，一定要为她猎取一些美味可口的肉。
那个倒下的人究竟怎么了？黑暗在她的耳边轻声低语，充满诱惑地撩拨着她。虐待他又怜爱他。折磨他又帮助他。和一只[暗影恶魔]一同身处这黑暗之中，纯粹就是一场令人毛骨悚然的噩梦。
很快，他放松了警惕，然后——
*嘎吱*
[等级提升。][等级提升。][等级提升。][等级提升。]……
[等级：20（第二次进化）]
[您可以进化为[无价值]兽类]
[进一步升级将允许您进化为[普通]兽类。]
艾可可爱地皱起了眉头，满心的不解。以前，达到10级就能够进化了，但如今却需要20级。这可实在不是个好消息，因为这意味着她得猎杀更多的野兽才能够实现升级。
她无奈地摇摇头，继续投入到“狩猎”之中。黑暗再次如同温柔的指引者，引领着她，她熟练地又抓伤了一个人。眼看着自己的耐力接近25%，她明智地拉开了与敌人的距离。
那些筑基巅峰的人敏锐地注意到了这一点，然而那些没有留意到的人还在盲目地四处乱扔烟火。
元婴修士已然到达了极限。“撤退——”*噗*
巴迪在那个元婴修士分心的瞬间，毫不犹豫地用蹄子猛击他的胸膛，给他造成了致命的重创。黑豹看到这一幕，如同一头迅猛的猎豹般扑向他，然后——
*嘎吱*
黑豹迅速地结果了他的性命。很快，所有人都命丧黄泉，无一幸免。
巴迪大口大口地喘着粗气。“我不行了，我伤得实在是太重了……”
“是啊，我的耐力也已经所剩无几了。”黑豹表示认同地点点头。
艾可再次轻盈地跳上他的背，惬意地躺了下来。

“看起来她也累得精疲力竭了，今天就到此为止吧。”马哼了一声，随后他们将这些人的财物洗劫一空，离开了这个血腥的地方。
……
一路上……
“你知道吗，我从未见过像您这样威风凛凛的野兽——”
黑豹拼命地讨好着艾可，艾可毫不领情地对他哼了一声。
巴迪高兴得忍不住大声嘲笑他。“一回到村子，我们就公平地分宝藏，你想怎么处置都行。”
艾可向他乖巧地点点头，耳朵欢快地扇动着，仿佛在表达着自己的喜悦。
黑豹深深地叹了口气，绞尽脑汁地努力回想自己家里是否还存着什么上好的肉……
……
“这边，这边。”
黑暗的声音悄然响起。艾可瞬间竖起耳朵，全神贯注地倾听着。
“这边，有宝藏，这边。”
content_en:
Ai Ke sprinted like lightning again, her figure looming in the night, like a meteor cutting through the darkness. Her heartbeat was as fast as a drum, and every breath seemed to be burning. She could clearly feel that her endurance was rapidly being depleted at an alarming rate. It seemed that this battle was about to become her last ditch effort before she had to retreat in embarrassment.
They fell into extreme panic. However, most of the substantial damage was actually caused by those at the peak of Foundation Establishment. They were extremely annoyed by her ghostly speed. Although their speed is much faster than Aike, it is not easy to accurately track her figure in this dense grass. In addition, they must always pay attention to avoid their companions... This series of situations does not help them at all.
She sprinted like lightning again, her keen eyesight saw someone lying in the grass, and she couldn't help but squint her eyes. The man then began to scream in terror, and the sound sent shivers down the Black Panther's spine. He once again vowed secretly in his heart that he would hunt some delicious meat for her.
What happened to the fallen man? The darkness whispered in her ears, teasing her seductively. Abuse him and love him. Torturing him and helping him. Being in this darkness with a [Shadow Demon] is simply a creepy nightmare.
Soon, he let down his guard, and then——
*crunch*
[Level up. ][Level up. ][Level up. ][Level up. ]......
[Level: 20 (second evolution)]
[You can evolve into a [worthless] beast]
[Further upgrades will allow you to evolve into a [normal] beast. ]
Aike frowned cutely, full of confusion. In the past, you could evolve after reaching level 10, but now you need level 20. This is really not good news, because it means that she has to hunt more beasts to upgrade.
She shook her head helplessly and continued to engage in "hunting". The darkness once again led her like a gentle guide, and she skillfully scratched another person. Seeing that her stamina was approaching 25%, she wisely distanced herself from the enemy.
Those who are at the peak of foundation building are keenly aware of this, but those who are not aware are still throwing fireworks around blindly.
The Nascent Soul cultivator has reached his limit. "Retreat——" *poof*
When the Nascent Soul cultivator was distracted, Buddy struck him in the chest with his hoof without hesitation, causing fatal injuries to him. When the black panther saw this scene, he pounced on him like a swift cheetah, and then——
*crunch*
The Black Panther quickly ended his life. Soon, everyone died and no one was spared.
Buddy gasped for air. "I can't survive, I'm too injured..."
"Yeah, I don't have much endurance left." Black Panther nodded in agreement.
Echo jumped onto his back lightly again and lay down comfortably.
"It looks like she is exhausted. Let's call it a day." Ma snorted, and then they looted these people's belongings and left this bloody place.
…
Along the way...
"You know, I've never seen a beast as majestic as you—"
The Black Panther desperately tried to please Aike, but Aike snorted at him without appreciation.
Buddy was so happy that he couldn't help but laugh at him loudly. "Once we return to the village, we will divide the treasure fairly and you can do whatever you want with it."
Echo nodded obediently to him, her ears flapping cheerfully, as if to express her joy.
The Black Panther sighed deeply and racked his brains to remember if he still had any good meat at home...
…
"This way, this way."
A dark voice sounded quietly. AiBut he immediately pricked up his ears and listened with all his attention.
"This way, there's a treasure, this way."
